title: A Double Zing on Day One — Part 3

series.summary: Rentaro begins his high school career and immediately locks eyes with two gorgeous classmates, Hakari and Karane. An electric shockwave strikes all three, sparking instant and overwhelming love.

segments.voiceover_text: Rentaro steps onto his new high school campus, praying the god's wild prophecy was just an absurd dream.
While crossing the entrance courtyard, he accidentally locks eyes with two gorgeous classmates, Hakari and Karane.
The instant their gazes meet, a violent romantic shockwave electrifies all three of their souls.
This is the legendary zing of destiny, sparking an uncontrollable passion that leaves Karane blushing furiously and Hakari starry-eyed.
Rentaro is struck with total panic: he has fallen madly in love with two different girls simultaneously, and neither girl has any intention of backing down.
